title: अध्याय १८

items.text:
ततस्तु देवा महिषेण निर्जिताः स्थानानि संत्यज्य सवाहनायुधाः।
जग्मुः पुरस्कृत्य पितामहं ते द्रष्टुं तदा चक्रधरं श्रियः पतिम् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
tatastu devā mahiṣeṇa nirjitāḥ sthānāni saṃtyajya savāhanāyudhāḥ|
jagmuḥ puraskṛtya pitāmahaṃ te draṣṭuṃ tadā cakradharaṃ śriyaḥ patim || 1 ||

items.text:
गत्वा त्वपश्यंश्च मिथः सुरोत्तमौ स्थितौ खगेन्द्रासनशंकरौ हि।
दृष्ट्वा प्रणम्यैव च सिद्दिसाधकौ न्यवेदयंस्तन्महिषादिचेष्टितम् ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
gatvā tvapaśyaṃśca mithaḥ surottamau sthitau khagendrāsanaśaṃkarau hi|
dṛṣṭvā praṇamyaiva ca siddisādhakau nyavedayaṃstanmahiṣādiceṣṭitam || 2 ||

items.text:
प्रभोऽश्विसूर्येन्द्वनिलाग्निवेधसां जलेशशक्रादिषु चाधिकारान्।
आक्रम्य नाकात्तु निराकृता वयं कृतावनिस्था महिषासुरेण ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
prabho'śvisūryendvanilāgnivedhasāṃ jaleśaśakrādiṣu cādhikārān|
ākramya nākāttu nirākṛtā vayaṃ kṛtāvanisthā mahiṣāsureṇa || 3 ||

items.text:
एतद् भवन्तौ शरणागतानां श्रुत्वा वचो ब्रूत हितं सुराणाम्।
न चेद् व्रजामोऽद्य रसातलं हि संकाल्यमाना युधि दानवेन ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
etad bhavantau śaraṇāgatānāṃ śrutvā vaco brūta hitaṃ surāṇām|
na ced vrajāmo'dya rasātalaṃ hi saṃkālyamānā yudhi dānavena || 4 ||

items.text:
इत्थं मुरारिः सह शंकरेण श्रुत्वा वचो विप्लुतचेतसस्तान्।
दृष्ट्वाऽथ चक्रे सहसैव कोपं कालाग्निकल्पो हरिरव्ययात्मा ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
itthaṃ murāriḥ saha śaṃkareṇa śrutvā vaco viplutacetasastān|
dṛṣṭvā'tha cakre sahasaiva kopaṃ kālāgnikalpo hariravyayātmā || 5 ||

items.text:
ततोऽनुकोपान्मधुसूदनस्य सशंकरस्यापि पितामहस्य।
तथैव शक्रादिषु दैवतेषु महर्द्धि तेजो वदनाद् विनिःसृतम् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
tato'nukopānmadhusūdanasya saśaṃkarasyāpi pitāmahasya|
tathaiva śakrādiṣu daivateṣu maharddhi tejo vadanād viniḥsṛtam || 6 ||

items.text:
तच्चैकतां पर्वतकूटसन्निभं जगाम तेजः प्रवराश्रमे मुने।
कात्यायनस्याप्रतिमस्य तेन महर्षिणा तेज उपाकृतं च ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
taccaikatāṃ parvatakūṭasannibhaṃ jagāma tejaḥ pravarāśrame mune|
kātyāyanasyāpratimasya tena maharṣiṇā teja upākṛtaṃ ca || 7 ||

items.text:
तेनार्षिसृष्टेन च तेजसा वृतं ज्वलत्प्रकाशार्कसहस्रतुल्यम्।
तस्माच्च जाता तरलायताक्षी कात्यायनी योगविशुद्धदेहा ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
tenārṣisṛṣṭena ca tejasā vṛtaṃ jvalatprakāśārkasahasratulyam|
tasmācca jātā taralāyatākṣī kātyāyanī yogaviśuddhadehā || 8 ||

items.text:
माहेश्वराद् वक्त्रमथो बभूव नेत्रत्रयं पावकतेजसा च।
याम्येन केशा हरितेजसा च भुजास्तथाष्टादश संप्रजज्ञिरे ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
māheśvarād vaktramatho babhūva netratrayaṃ pāvakatejasā ca|
yāmyena keśā haritejasā ca bhujāstathāṣṭādaśa saṃprajajñire || 9 ||

items.text:
सौम्येन युग्मं स्तनयोः सुसंहतं मध्यं तथैन्द्रेण च तेजसाऽभवत्।
ऊरू च जङ्घे च नितम्बसंयुते जाते जलेशस्य तु तेजसा हि ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
saumyena yugmaṃ stanayoḥ susaṃhataṃ madhyaṃ tathaindreṇa ca tejasā'bhavat|
ūrū ca jaṅghe ca nitambasaṃyute jāte jaleśasya tu tejasā hi || 10 ||

items.text:
पादौ च लोकप्रपितामहस्य पद्माभिकोशप्रतिमौ बभूवतुः।
दिवाकराणमपि तेजसाऽङ्गुलीः कराङ्गुलीश्च वसुतेजसैव ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
pādau ca lokaprapitāmahasya padmābhikośapratimau babhūvatuḥ|
divākarāṇamapi tejasā'ṅgulīḥ karāṅgulīśca vasutejasaiva || 11 ||

items.text:
प्रजापतीनां दशनाश्च तेजसा याक्षेण नासा श्रवणौ च मारुतात्।
साध्येन च भ्रूयुगलं सुकान्तिमत् कन्दर्पबाणासनसन्निभं बभौ ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
prajāpatīnāṃ daśanāśca tejasā yākṣeṇa nāsā śravaṇau ca mārutāt|
sādhyena ca bhrūyugalaṃ sukāntimat kandarpabāṇāsanasannibhaṃ babhau || 12 ||

items.text:
तथार्षितेजोत्तममुत्तमं महन्नाम्ना पृथिव्यामभवत् प्रसिद्धम्।
कात्यायनीत्येव तदा बभौ सा नाम्ना च तेनैव जगत्प्रसिद्धा ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
tathārṣitejottamamuttamaṃ mahannāmnā pṛthivyāmabhavat prasiddham|
kātyāyanītyeva tadā babhau sā nāmnā ca tenaiva jagatprasiddhā || 13 ||

items.text:
ददौ त्रिशूलं वरदस्त्रिशूली चक्रं मुरारिर्वरुणश्च शङ्खम्।
शक्तिं हुताशः श्वसनश्च चापं तूणौ तथाक्षय्यशरौ विवस्वान् ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
dadau triśūlaṃ varadastriśūlī cakraṃ murārirvaruṇaśca śaṅkham|
śaktiṃ hutāśaḥ śvasanaśca cāpaṃ tūṇau tathākṣayyaśarau vivasvān || 14 ||

items.text:
वज्रं तथेन्द्रः सह घण्टया च यमोऽथ दण्डं धनदो गदां च।
ब्रह्मऽक्षमालां सकमण्डलुं च कालोऽसिमुग्रं सह चर्मणा च ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
vajraṃ tathendraḥ saha ghaṇṭayā ca yamo'tha daṇḍaṃ dhanado gadāṃ ca|
brahma'kṣamālāṃ sakamaṇḍaluṃ ca kālo'simugraṃ saha carmaṇā ca || 15 ||

items.text:
हारं च सोमः सह चामरेण मालं समुद्रो हिमवान् मृगेन्द्रम्।
चूडामणिं कुण्डलमर्द्धचन्द्रं प्रादात् कुठारं वसुशिल्पकर्त्ता ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
hāraṃ ca somaḥ saha cāmareṇa mālaṃ samudro himavān mṛgendram|
cūḍāmaṇiṃ kuṇḍalamarddhacandraṃ prādāt kuṭhāraṃ vasuśilpakarttā || 16 ||

items.text:
गन्धर्वराजो रजतानुलिप्तं पानस्य पूर्णं सदृशं च भाजनम्।
भुजंगहारं भुजगेश्वरोऽपि अम्लानपुष्पामृतवः स्रजं च ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
gandharvarājo rajatānuliptaṃ pānasya pūrṇaṃ sadṛśaṃ ca bhājanam|
bhujaṃgahāraṃ bhujageśvaro'pi amlānapuṣpāmṛtavaḥ srajaṃ ca || 17 ||

items.text:
तदाऽतितुष्टा सुरसत्तमानां अट्टाट्टहासं मुमुचे त्रिनेत्रा।
तां तुष्टुवुर्देववराः सहेन्द्राः सविष्णुरुद्रेन्द्वनिलाग्निभास्कराः ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
tadā'tituṣṭā surasattamānāṃ aṭṭāṭṭahāsaṃ mumuce trinetrā|
tāṃ tuṣṭuvurdevavarāḥ sahendrāḥ saviṣṇurudrendvanilāgnibhāskarāḥ || 18 ||

items.text:
नमोऽस्तु दैव्यै सुरपूजितायै या संस्थिता योगविशुद्धदेहा।
निद्रास्वरूपेण महीं वितत्य तृष्णा त्रपा क्षुद् भयदाऽथ कान्तिः ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
namo'stu daivyai surapūjitāyai yā saṃsthitā yogaviśuddhadehā|
nidrāsvarūpeṇa mahīṃ vitatya tṛṣṇā trapā kṣud bhayadā'tha kāntiḥ || 19 ||

items.text:
श्रद्धा स्मृतिः पुष्टिरथो क्षमा च छाया च शक्तिः कमलालया च।
वृत्तिर्दया भ्रान्ति रथेह माया नमोऽस्तु दैव्यै भवरूपिकायै ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
śraddhā smṛtiḥ puṣṭiratho kṣamā ca chāyā ca śaktiḥ kamalālayā ca|
vṛttirdayā bhrānti ratheha māyā namo'stu daivyai bhavarūpikāyai || 20 ||

items.text:
ततः स्तुताः देववरैर्मृगेन्द्रमारुह्य देवी प्रगताऽवनीध्रम्।
विन्ध्यं महापर्वतमुच्चश्रृङ्गं चकार यं निम्नतरं त्वगस्त्यः ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
tataḥ stutāḥ devavarairmṛgendramāruhya devī pragatā'vanīdhram|
vindhyaṃ mahāparvatamuccaśrṛṅgaṃ cakāra yaṃ nimnataraṃ tvagastyaḥ || 21 ||

items.text:
किर्मथमद्रिं भगवानगस्त्यस्तं निम्नश्रृङ्गं कृतवान् महर्षिः।
कस्मै कृते केन च कारणेन एतद् वदस्वामलसत्त्ववृत्ते ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
kirmathamadriṃ bhagavānagastyastaṃ nimnaśrṛṅgaṃ kṛtavān maharṣiḥ|
kasmai kṛte kena ca kāraṇena etad vadasvāmalasattvavṛtte || 22 ||

items.text:
पुरा हि विन्ध्येन दिवाकरस्य गतिर्निरुद्धा गगनेचरस्य।
रविस्ततः कुम्भभवं समेत्य होमावसाने वचनं बभाषे ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
purā hi vindhyena divākarasya gatirniruddhā gaganecarasya|
ravistataḥ kumbhabhavaṃ sametya homāvasāne vacanaṃ babhāṣe || 23 ||

items.text:
समागतोऽहं द्विज दूरतस्त्वां कुरुष्व मामुद्धरणं मुनीन्द्र।
ददस्व दानं मम यन्मनीषिनं चरामि येन त्रिदिवेषु निर्वृतः ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
samāgato'haṃ dvija dūratastvāṃ kuruṣva māmuddharaṇaṃ munīndra|
dadasva dānaṃ mama yanmanīṣinaṃ carāmi yena tridiveṣu nirvṛtaḥ || 24 ||

items.text:
इत्थं दिवाकरवचो गुणसंप्रयोगि श्रुत्वा तदा कलशजो वचनं बभाषे।
दानं ददामि तव यन्मनसस्त्वभीष्टं नार्थि प्रयाति विमुखो मम कश्चिदेव ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
itthaṃ divākaravaco guṇasaṃprayogi śrutvā tadā kalaśajo vacanaṃ babhāṣe|
dānaṃ dadāmi tava yanmanasastvabhīṣṭaṃ nārthi prayāti vimukho mama kaścideva || 25 ||

items.text:
श्रुत्वा वचोऽमृतमयं कलशोद्भवस्य प्राह प्रभुः करतले विनिधाय मूर्ध्नि।
एषोऽद्य मे गिरिवरः प्ररुणाद्धि मार्गं विन्ध्यस्य निम्नकरणे भगवन् यतस्व ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
śrutvā vaco'mṛtamayaṃ kalaśodbhavasya prāha prabhuḥ karatale vinidhāya mūrdhni|
eṣo'dya me girivaraḥ praruṇāddhi mārgaṃ vindhyasya nimnakaraṇe bhagavan yatasva || 26 ||

items.text:
इति रविवचनादथाह कुम्भजन्मा कुतमिति विद्धि मया हि नीचश्रृङ्गम्।
तव किरणजितो भविष्यते महीध्रो मम चरणसमाश्रितस्य का व्यथा ते ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
iti ravivacanādathāha kumbhajanmā kutamiti viddhi mayā hi nīcaśrṛṅgam|
tava kiraṇajito bhaviṣyate mahīdhro mama caraṇasamāśritasya kā vyathā te || 27 ||

items.text:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा कलशोद्भवस्तु सूर्यं हि संस्तूय विनम्य भक्त्या।
जगाम संत्यज्य हि दण्डकं हि विन्ध्याचलं वृद्‌धवपुर्महर्षिः ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
ityevamuktvā kalaśodbhavastu sūryaṃ hi saṃstūya vinamya bhaktyā|
jagāma saṃtyajya hi daṇḍakaṃ hi vindhyācalaṃ vṛddhavapurmaharṣiḥ || 28 ||

items.text:
गत्वा वचः प्राह मुनिर्महीध्रं यास्ये महातीर्थवरं सुपुण्यम्।
वृद्धोस्म्यशक्तश्च तवाधिरोढुं तस्माद् भवान् नीचतरोऽस्तु सद्यः ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
gatvā vacaḥ prāha munirmahīdhraṃ yāsye mahātīrthavaraṃ supuṇyam|
vṛddhosmyaśaktaśca tavādhiroḍhuṃ tasmād bhavān nīcataro'stu sadyaḥ || 29 ||

items.text:
इत्येवमुक्तो मुनिसत्तमेन स नीचश्रृङ्गस्त्वभवन्महीध्रः।
समाक्रमच्चापि महर्षिमुकख्यः प्रोल्लङ्घ्य विन्ध्यं त्विदमाह शैलम् ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
ityevamukto munisattamena sa nīcaśrṛṅgastvabhavanmahīdhraḥ|
samākramaccāpi maharṣimukakhyaḥ prollaṅghya vindhyaṃ tvidamāha śailam || 30 ||

items.text:
यावन्न भूयो निजमाव्रजामि महाश्रमं धौतवपुः सुतीर्थात्।
त्वया न तावत्त्विह वर्धितव्यं नो चेद् विशप्स्येऽहमवज्ञया ते ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
yāvanna bhūyo nijamāvrajāmi mahāśramaṃ dhautavapuḥ sutīrthāt|
tvayā na tāvattviha vardhitavyaṃ no ced viśapsye'hamavajñayā te || 31 ||

items.text:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा भगवाञ्जगाम दिशं स याम्यां सहसाऽन्तरिक्षम्।
आक्रम्य तस्थौ स हि तां तदाशां काले व्रजाम्यत्र यदा मुनीन्द्रः ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
ityevamuktvā bhagavāñjagāma diśaṃ sa yāmyāṃ sahasā'ntarikṣam|
ākramya tasthau sa hi tāṃ tadāśāṃ kāle vrajāmyatra yadā munīndraḥ || 32 ||

items.text:
तत्राश्रमं रम्यतरं हि कृत्वा संशुद्धजाम्बूनदतोरणान्तम्।
तत्राथ निक्षिप्य विदर्भपुत्रीं स्वमाश्रमं सौम्यमुपाजगाम ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
tatrāśramaṃ ramyataraṃ hi kṛtvā saṃśuddhajāmbūnadatoraṇāntam|
tatrātha nikṣipya vidarbhaputrīṃ svamāśramaṃ saumyamupājagāma || 33 ||

items.text:
ऋतावृतौ पर्वकालेषु नित्यं तमम्बरे ह्याश्रममावसत् सः।
शेषं च कालं स हि दण्डकस्थस्तपश्चचारामितकान्तिमान् मुनिः ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
ṛtāvṛtau parvakāleṣu nityaṃ tamambare hyāśramamāvasat saḥ|
śeṣaṃ ca kālaṃ sa hi daṇḍakasthastapaścacārāmitakāntimān muniḥ || 34 ||

items.text:
विनन्ध्योऽपि दृष्ट्वा गगने महाश्रमं वृद्धिं न यात्येव भयान्महर्षेः।
नासौ निवृत्तेति मतिं विधाय स संस्थितो नीचतराग्रश्रृङ्गः ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
vinandhyo'pi dṛṣṭvā gagane mahāśramaṃ vṛddhiṃ na yātyeva bhayānmaharṣeḥ|
nāsau nivṛtteti matiṃ vidhāya sa saṃsthito nīcatarāgraśrṛṅgaḥ || 35 ||

items.text:
एवं त्वगस्त्येन महाचलेन्द्रः स नीचश्रृङ्गे हि कृतो महर्षे।
तस्योर्ध्वश्रृङ्गे मुनिसंस्तुता सा दुर्गा स्थिता दानवनाशनार्थम् ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ tvagastyena mahācalendraḥ sa nīcaśrṛṅge hi kṛto maharṣe|
tasyordhvaśrṛṅge munisaṃstutā sā durgā sthitā dānavanāśanārtham || 36 ||

items.text:
देवाश्च सिद्धाश्च महोरगाश्च विद्याधरा भूतगणाश्च सर्वे।
सर्वाप्सरोभिः प्रतिरामयन्तः कात्यायनीं तस्थुरपेतशोकाः ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
devāśca siddhāśca mahoragāśca vidyādharā bhūtagaṇāśca sarve|
sarvāpsarobhiḥ pratirāmayantaḥ kātyāyanīṃ tasthurapetaśokāḥ || 37 ||

en_summary: Pulastya continues. Defeated by Mahisha, the gods left their places and, led by Brahma, went to Vishnu, whom they found with Shiva. They told them that Mahisha had taken over the offices of the Ashvins, Sun, Moon, Wind, Fire, Brahma, Varuna and Indra and driven them from heaven to live on earth, and asked for help, or else they would have to flee to the underworld. Hearing this, Vishnu became angry like the fire of the world's end, and from his face, and from the faces of Shiva, Brahma, Indra and the other gods, came a great blaze of energy. It joined into one mass like a mountain peak at the hermitage of the sage Katyayana, who added his own energy to it, and from that blaze, bright as a thousand suns, was born Katyayani, with long, shining eyes and a body pure through yoga. From Shiva's energy came her face, from Fire her three eyes, from Yama her hair, from Vishnu her eighteen arms, from the Moon her breasts, from Indra her waist, from Varuna her thighs, shanks and hips, from Brahma her lotus-like feet, from the Suns her toes, from the Vasus her fingers, from the Prajapatis her teeth, from the Yakshas her nose, from the Wind her ears and from the Sadhyas her eyebrows like Kama's bow. Because this energy came through the sage, she became famous as Katyayani. The gods gave her weapons and ornaments: Shiva a trident, Vishnu a discus, Varuna a conch, Fire a spear, Wind a bow, the Sun two quivers with endless arrows, Indra a thunderbolt and a bell, Yama a staff, Kubera a mace, Brahma a rosary and water pot, Time a sword and shield, the Moon a necklace and whisk, the Ocean a garland, Himavan a lion to ride, Vishvakarma a crest jewel, earrings, a half-moon and an axe, the king of the Gandharvas a silver drinking cup, the lord of serpents a snake necklace, and the Seasons a garland of unfading flowers. Pleased, the three-eyed goddess laughed loudly, and the gods praised her as the goddess who spreads over the earth as sleep, thirst, shame, hunger, fear, beauty, faith, memory, nourishment, patience, shadow, power, Lakshmi, livelihood, mercy, confusion and illusion. Then she rode her lion to the Vindhya mountain, whose high peaks Agastya had once made low. Narada asks why Agastya did this. Pulastya says that long ago the Vindhya blocked the path of the Sun in the sky. The Sun came to Agastya, the sage born from a jar, at the end of his fire offering, and asked him for a gift. Agastya said no one who asks of him goes away disappointed, and the Sun asked him to make the Vindhya low, since it blocked his path. Agastya promised it, praised and bowed to the Sun, and, as an old man, left the Dandaka forest and went to the Vindhya. He told the mountain he was going to a great holy place, was old and could not climb it, and asked it to become low at once. The mountain lowered its peaks, Agastya crossed over and told it not to grow again until he returned from his bath at the holy place, or he would curse it for disobeying. He then went south through the sky, built a beautiful hermitage with gates of pure gold, left his wife, the princess of Vidarbha, there, and returned to his own hermitage. He stays in the sky hermitage at every season and holy time, and spends the rest of the time doing penance in the Dandaka forest. Seeing the hermitage in the sky, the Vindhya does not grow for fear of the sage, thinking he has not returned, and stays low. On its high peak Durga, praised by the sages, took her place to destroy the demons, and the gods, siddhas, serpents, Vidyadharas, spirits and apsaras stayed there with Katyayani, free of sorrow.
